_comment: The MODEL schema, as DATA. A model is the content a consumer hands the viewer — axes, cells and views — and this file is the single statement of its shape, read by BOTH validators (preview3d/model.py and src/model.js). Stating it once is why a consumer's model cannot pass one renderer and fail the other. The schema language is deliberately tiny; it is described in full in MODELS.md.

_language.type: one of the primitive types below, or the name of a type declared in `types`

primitives.vector3: an array of exactly 3 finite numbers
primitives.direction: a direction token like '+x' or '+x-y+z', or a vector3; must not be zero-length

field.keys: for `map`: '*' for any string, '@dotted.path' for a list in shared/spec.json, '$field' for a list on the model itself
field.enum: a literal list, or '@dotted.path' / '$field' as above
field.length: for `array`: the exact number of elements

axis._comment: An axis is a LINE: two opposite ends, each with its own direction, colour and vocabulary. `tier` decides its dress and its group in the scene tree.

cell._comment: A seat of the cube: a face centre, an edge midpoint, a vertex, or the centre itself.

glass._comment: The cube shell the cells are seen through. Absent means the model has no shell.

view._comment: A named preset over ONE model — which groups speak, how opaque, and where the camera stands. The four owner models are four of these, never four hand-built scenes.

names._comment: register -> the seat's two readings. Every register the model declares must be present, so a switcher position can never find nothing to say.
